overview.description: The Roundhill ARM WeeklyPay ETF (ARMW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed fund seeking to provide weekly distributions and 1.2x leveraged exposure to the weekly price return of ARM Holdings PLC stock (NASDAQ: ARM develops and licenses energy-efficient CPU cores, graphics processors, and system IP, serving markets including smartphones, automotive, IoT, and data centers. ARMW was launched on Oct 23, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
